content: अक्षेत्र {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] Destitute of fields; uncultivated. .{@-त्रम्@} .²1 A bad field (अप्रशस्तम् क्षेत्रम्); अक्षेत्रे बीजमुत्सृष्टमन्तरैव विनश्यति <ls>Ms. 10. 71</ls>. .²2 Not a good geometrical figure. .²3 (<ab>fig.</ab>) A bad pupil, unworthy recipient or receptacle (of anything).
